title: PRESS NOTE
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Law and Justice

PRESS NOTE

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
08 AUG 2026 1:27PM by PIB Delhi

In exercise of the powers conferred by the Constitution of India, in consultation with Chief Justice of India, the President is pleased to appoint the following Advocates/ Judicial Officers as Judges / Additional Judges in the High Courts:-



S. No.

Name of the recommendee (S/Shri)

Details



Govindarajan Krishnaswamy, Advocate

Appointed as Judges of the Madras High Court



Rajnish Pathiyil, Advocate



Ramesh Natarajan, Advocate



G.K. Muthukumaar, Advocate



Ramakrishnan Rajesh Vivekananthan, Advocate



Raveekumar Sankaranarayanan, Advocate







Appointed as Additional Judges of the Madras High Court



Dilip Kumar Nagarajan, Advocate



Ellappan Manoharan, Advocate



Dr. P. Murugan, Judicial Officer



Smt. M. D. Sumathi, Judicial Officer



Smt. S. Alli, Judicial Officer



Smt. C. Thirumagal, Judicial Officer



Shanmugam Karthikeyan, Judicial Officer



Murugesan Baluchamy, Judicial Officer



N. Gunasekaran, Judicial Officer



Aryak Dutt, Advocate

Appointed as Additional Judges of the Calcutta High Court



Atarup Banerjee, Advocate



Sandip Kumar De, Advocate



Partha Pratim Roy, Advocate



Sudip Deb, Advocate



Anuj Singh, Advocate



Arjun Ray Mukherjee , Advocate



Rishad Medora, Advocate



Raghavendra Seetharam Srivatsa, Advocate

Appointed as Additional Judges of the Karnataka High Court



Smt. Hema Kulkarni, Advocate



Subramanya Rangarao, Advocate



Vivekananda Thadagavadi Prakash, Advocate



Pramod Bakkeswara, Advocate



Shanthi Bhushan Hombe Gowda, Advocate



Amit Lahoti, Advocate

Appointed as an Additional Judge of the Madhya Pradesh  High Court



*****

Samrat/sagar

(रिलीज़ आईडी: 2296475)
